name: BFL Asset Finvest Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, BFL Asset Finvest 
Ltd deals in shares and stock trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
BFLAFVL is engaged in the business of dealing and trading in shares, securities, commodities, futures, and options, etc, in the financial and capital markets. The co. is registered as a Non-Banking Non-Deposit Taking Non-Systemically Important Investment and Credit Company, and 
is categorized as the NBFC-Base Layer
 under Scale-Based Supervision Regulation 
(SBSR)

pros: Stock is trading at 0.54 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.76% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 58.4 to 87.7 days.
